{{Trail|Items}}{{TOCright}}
This page summarizes all of the '''Specialty Gear''' in Skyrim. These are items that can be found in many locations in the game, yet do not qualify as generic weapons or generic armor. For example, it includes weapons and armor that are only used by specific races or factions (e.g., the Stormcloaks, the Thieves Guild, the Blades). It also includes some items, such as pickaxes and woodcutter's axes, that are only used in certain situations.

*[[Skyrim:Followers|Followers]] inducted into the Blades also carry one, and it can be obtained from their inventory when they are actively following you.

{{Bug|Apart from the armor rating of the cuirass, which exceeds the [[Skyrim:Ebony Armor|ebony cuirass]] by 1 point, all stats are identical to [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armor|dwarven armor]]. As of patch 1.9, the armor qualifies for matching set bonuses with the [[Skyrim:Steel Plate Armor|steel plate armor]], though it does not benefit from any perk to improve it twice as much.|USKP|2.0.6|The armor rating has been lowered to 34, equal to dwarven. This lowers the total with shield to 104, and without shield to 78.}}
{{Bug|The shield may become invisible for unknown reasons, especially with vampires.|OSSEP|1.7}}
* The [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]] armor can be obtained from a chest in [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]] after completing [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]], or looted from the body of [[Skyrim:Lorant Bouchard|Lorant Bouchard]], if you have the [[Skyrim:Dawnfang & Duskfang|Dawnfang & Duskfang]] creation installed. 
* Oddly enough, the Blades Sword has an associated perk (Steel), whereas the Blades Armor set does not. This seems inconsistent, given that all of the items need a Steel Ingot to temper them.

{{bug|When picking up the versions that cannot be equipped by the player, they turn invisible in the inventory and can't be dropped. They still add to the carry weight, though. It's the armor found in the master bedroom next to the bed. On the PC they can be dropped with the console command <code>player.drop ID 1</code>, where ID is the respective item ID found in the table.|USKP|1.2}}
{{bug|Although the Worn Shrouded Gloves display an enchantment in-game, no such enchantment is applied. If the player wishes, a custom enchantment can be applied to the gloves at an [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]]. Even with a custom enchantment, the description will still read ''"Backstab does double damage"''.|USKP|1.3.2}}
{{Note|WA||{{Bug|Worn Shrouded armors cannot be tempered.|fixedby=USKP|fixversion=1.0|nobullet=1}}}}
{{Note|Cowl|††|{{Bug|The Worn Shrouded Cowl has no model for Argonians or Khajiit. Characters of these races attempting to equip the hood will appear bald. This also enables players to equip it alongside other headgear.|confirmed=1|nobullet=1}}}}
{{Note|Gloves|‡|The ability to disenchant the Worn Shrouded Gloves was added by the [[Skyrim:USKP|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]]. However, the effect learned cannot be used to enchant an item.}}

''Especially effective against undead.''
*Silver weapons can be found wielded by Silver Hand members during the Companions questline.
**A Silver Sword can also be found in Valerica's Study.
*Silver weapons add +20 to their base damage when attacking [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolves]], [[Skyrim:Werebear|werebears]]{{DB}}, and [[Skyrim:Undead|undead]], including some ghosts (ghostly animals are still animals, and some humanoid ghosts are still marked as their base race instead) and [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]]s. Your character's weapon skill does not affect this hidden enchantment. The Barbarian and Armsman perks, however, do affect it. 
{{Bug|This effect is not considered an enchantment, so silver weapons can be [[Skyrim:Enchanting|enchanted]] like any normal unenchanted weapon, though they will always display the text "Especially effective against undead."|USKP|1.0|Enchantment text is made visible but for this to work the notice about undead had to be removed, and information is now provided via a loading screen text entry.}}
**{{pc22}} PC players can use the mod [[Skyrim Mod:Enchantable Special Item Fix|Enchantable Special Item Fix]] to instead properly concatenate the text so they can see both the intrinsic special effect and the added enchantments.
{{Bug|Using a spell (healing, oak flesh) while holding a silver weapon negates the extra damage, re-equipping the weapon fixes this. Tested on Special Edition.|vn=1}}
{{bug|Sometimes silver weapons do not show any description text.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|Silver weapons cannot be improved at a grindstone.|USKP|1.0|Tempering is made possible with a [[skyrim:Silver|silver ingot]].}}
|-
| [[File:SR-icon-weapon-SilverGreatsword.png|48px]]
| {{Anchor|Silver Greatsword}}<br>{{ID|0010c6fb|par=1}} || Two-Handed Sword || possible
| 12 || 160 || 17
